_comment: Markers of YOUR personal layer. Replace these with strings that only appear in
your own instruction files, persona, or config -- your name, your project
codenames, your persona's name, your config filenames.
Do NOT add generic agent scaffolding here (tool descriptions, MCP server lists,
'you are a coding assistant'): every vendor has it, it is symmetric across rails,
and flagging it makes every rail permanently dirty.
Entries are regexes, OR-ed together, matched case-insensitively.
Note: passing this file REPLACES the built-in default filename list -- re-add any
